discription: FM synthesis-based plucked string sound with a percussive envelope, allowing control over modulation ratio and index.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modRatio=1.5, modIndex=1.5;    var sig, env;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.perc(0.01, 0.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var modulator = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (freq * modIndex);    sig = SinOsc.ar(freq + modulator) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
